name: Imatinib
dailyMed_observation: CYP3A4 is the major enzyme responsible for metabolism of imatinib.

name: Gefitinib
dailyMed_observation: Gefitinib undergoes extensive hepatic metabolism in humans, predominantly by CYP3A4.

name: Erlotinib
dailyMed_observation: Erlotinib is metabolized primarily by CYP3A4 and to a lesser extent by CYP1A2 and CYP1A1 in vitro.
